text: A crystal-field scavenger armoured in singing stone. Keep your distance from its heavy shove.
Shardbacks roam the March Crystal Fields.
It has **36 health** and **8 armour** and hits for **5**. Every blow shoves you back hard, which is dangerous on the terraces. Fight it away from ledges.
pages.title: Where and how

text: A Prism Carapace attunes into 2 Attuned Echoes under Spirit.
pages.title: What it gives

text: Reach **Voice** standing with the **Grit-singers**, then use a Bonding Charm on an adult. Two tries in five succeed; a failed charm is spent.
A bonded Shardback is a fighter: it strikes whoever hurts you and whoever you strike. The rare **Brace** mark makes it hard to knock back. See [familiar gifts](familiar_gifts).
